title: Classic Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently and constantly until just set but still soft.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Spoon the eggs over the toast and serve immediately.

title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl beat eggs with milk and melted butter.
Fold the wet into the dry until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Cook ladles of batter on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, then flip.
Serve warm with syrup or fruit.

title: Veggie Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Saute diced onion and bell pepper in butter until soft.
Pour eggs over the vegetables and cook until nearly set.
Sprinkle cheese over one half and fold the omelette over.
Slide onto a plate and serve.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fry or poach an egg to your liking.
Spread avocado on the toast and top with the egg.
Finish with chili flakes and extra salt.

title: Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, and yogurt in a jar.
Stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with sliced banana and enjoy cold.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Gently sizzle sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil until fragrant.
Toss the drained pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water.
Stir through chopped parsley.
Serve with grated parmesan.

title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.
Saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and season with salt.
Toss with the pasta and finish with torn basil.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Crisp chopped bacon with a smashed garlic clove.
Whisk eggs with grated parmesan and lots of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss hot pasta with the bacon, then the egg mixture, adding pasta water to make a silky sauce.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

title: Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.
Blend basil, garlic, pine nuts, parmesan, and olive oil into a pesto.
Toss the drained pasta with the pesto and a little pasta water.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni until al dente and drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then slowly add milk to make a smooth sauce.
Stir in grated cheese until melted and season with salt and pepper.
Fold the pasta into the sauce.
Serve hot, or bake briefly for a crispy top.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Slice chicken and stir-fry in hot oil until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and chopped vegetables; stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Splash in soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over the rice.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, day-old rice for best results.
Scramble the eggs in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry onion, carrot, garlic, and peas until tender.
Add the rice and soy sauce, tossing over high heat.
Fold the eggs back in and serve.

title: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry until golden.
Cook rice on the side.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and vegetables in sesame oil.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, and toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

title: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Slice beef thinly and toss with a little cornstarch and soy sauce.
Sear the beef in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger.
Return the beef, add soy sauce and a splash of water, and simmer until glossy.
Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, peppers, and onion.
Toss the chicken with cumin, paprika, and salt.
Sear the chicken in hot oil, then add the vegetables until charred and tender.
Squeeze over lime juice.
Serve in warm tortillas.

title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Saute onion and garlic until soft.
Add black beans and cumin; mash lightly and warm through.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beans, cheese, and cilantro.
Finish with a squeeze of lime.

title: Fish Tacos
steps: Season white fish with cumin, paprika, and salt.
Pan-fry the fish until it flakes easily.
Mix mayo with lime juice for a quick crema.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Assemble tacos with fish, cabbage, crema, and cilantro.

title: Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic.
Stir in cumin, paprika, and salt with a splash of water.
Simmer until saucy.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, cheese, and shredded lettuce.

title: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
steps: Heat the oven as hot as it goes.
Spread crushed tomatoes seasoned with garlic and salt over the flatbread.
Top with torn mozzarella.
Bake until the cheese bubbles and the edges crisp.
Finish with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion into chunks.
Add olives and cubed feta.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, and dried oregano.
Toss gently and season with salt.

title: Caesar Salad
steps: Toast cubed bread with olive oil and garlic to make croutons.
Whisk mayo, lemon juice, mustard, grated parmesan, and garlic into a dressing.
Toss chopped romaine with the dressing.
Top with croutons and extra parmesan.

title: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and fresh mozzarella.
Arrange alternating slices on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
Combine with chickpeas and chopped parsley.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

title: Tomato Soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add canned tomatoes and vegetable stock, then simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in a splash of cream and season with salt.
Garnish with basil.

title: Lentil Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil.
Stir in cumin, then add lentils and vegetable stock.
Simmer 25-30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and blend partly for a thicker texture if desired.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot, celery, and garlic.
Add chicken and chicken stock; simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Shred the chicken and return it to the pot.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Season with salt and finish with parsley.

title: Miso Soup
steps: Heat dashi until warm but not boiling.
Whisk in miso paste until dissolved.
Add cubed tofu and rehydrated seaweed.
Warm gently and finish with sliced green onion.

title: Minestrone Soup
steps: Saute onion, carrot, and celery until soft.
Add canned tomatoes, beans, and vegetable stock.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add pasta and diced zucchini.
Cook until the pasta is tender and season with salt.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter the outside of two slices of bread.
Layer cheese between them, buttered sides out.
Grill in a pan over medium heat until golden.
Flip and cook until the cheese melts.
Slice and serve hot.

title: Quesadilla
steps: Saute sliced pepper and onion until soft.
Lay a tortilla in a dry pan and cover half with cheese and the vegetables.
Fold over and cook until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Saute onion, pepper, and garlic in olive oil.
Add cumin and paprika, then the canned tomatoes.
Simmer until thickened and season with salt.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set but the yolks stay soft.

title: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar, and vanilla.
Soak bread slices briefly in the mixture.
Fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with syrup or fruit.

title: Banana Smoothie
steps: Add banana, milk, yogurt, honey, and ice to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

title: Fruit Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of granola and fruit.
Repeat the layers.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Baked Salmon with Vegetables
steps: Toss chopped potato and broccoli with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast the vegetables until they begin to soften.
Add salmon fillets and lemon slices to the tray.
Bake until the salmon flakes easily.
Serve with the roasted vegetables.

title: Roast Chicken Thighs with Potatoes
steps: Toss potatoes and garlic with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Nestle chicken thighs on top and squeeze over lemon.
Roast until the chicken skin is crisp and the potatoes are tender.
Rest briefly and serve.

title: Beef Chili
steps: Brown the ground beef with onion, garlic, and pepper.
Stir in cumin and chili powder.
Add canned tomatoes and beans.
Simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Vegetable Curry
steps: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger.
Stir in curry powder until fragrant.
Add potato, cauliflower, and coconut milk; simmer until tender.
Add peas at the end.
Serve over rice.

title: Chicken Curry
steps: Brown the chicken pieces and set aside.
Saute onion, garlic, and ginger, then add curry powder.
Add canned tomatoes and coconut milk.
Return the chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Serve over rice.

title: Fried Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Warm cooked rice in a bowl.
Fry eggs in oil until the edges are crispy.
Place the eggs over the rice.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with sliced green onion.

title: Hummus and Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread hummus over a tortilla.
Layer sliced cucumber, tomato, carrot, and lettuce.
Squeeze over a little lemon.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

title: Tuna Melt
steps: Mix tuna with mayo, finely diced onion, and celery.
Spread onto bread and top with cheese.
Butter the outside of the sandwich.
Grill in a pan until golden and the cheese melts.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Cook rice and brown the beef with onion, garlic, and cumin.
Mix in canned tomatoes.
Halve and seed the peppers and fill them with the mixture.
Top with cheese and bake until the peppers are tender.
Serve hot.

title: Egg Fried Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Scramble the eggs in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, cabbage, and carrot until crisp-tender.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, tossing over high heat.
Fold in the eggs and green onion.

title: Potato and Leek Soup
steps: Soften sliced leek, onion, and garlic in butter.
Add diced potato and vegetable stock.
Simmer until the potato is soft.
Blend until smooth and stir in cream.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Bruschetta
steps: Toast slices of bread and rub with a cut garlic clove.
Dice tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, olive oil, and salt.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the toast.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and serve.

title: Frittata
steps: Saute diced potato and onion in an ovenproof pan until tender.
Add spinach until wilted.
Beat eggs with cheese, salt, and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Cook until the edges set, then finish under the broiler until puffed and golden.

title: Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, lime juice, and honey with a little warm water.
Toss the noodles in the sauce.
Top with sliced green onion and serve warm or cold.

title: Sausage and Pepper Skillet
steps: Brown sliced sausage in olive oil.
Add sliced peppers, onion, and garlic; cook until soft.
Stir in canned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve on its own or with bread.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Melt butter and sizzle minced garlic with chili flakes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and opaque.
Squeeze over lemon juice and season with salt.
Finish with chopped parsley and serve with bread or rice.

title: Caprese Grilled Cheese
steps: Layer mozzarella, sliced tomato, and basil between two slices of bread.
Add a few drops of balsamic vinegar.
Butter the outsides and grill until golden.
Flip and cook until the cheese melts.

title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Bowl
steps: Toss cubed sweet potato with olive oil, cumin, and salt and roast until tender.
Warm the black beans and cook rice.
Build bowls with rice, sweet potato, and beans.
Top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
